description:
Get per-entity Digital Asset Treasury RAW DATA (JSON). For CHARTS use render_chart instead — it's faster and doesn't overflow context.
Common entities: Strategy/MSTR (id=1), Metaplanet (id=4), MARA Holdings (id=5), Riot Platforms (id=7), Block.one (id=8), Tesla (id=11), El Salvador (id=35), United States (id=45).
Accepts entity ID or name/ticker. Use search_dat_entities to find others.
⚠️ For visualization: render_chart({ metrics: [{id: "dat_entity_holdings", axis: "left"}, {id: "dat_entity_realized_price", axis: "right"}], params: {entity: "strategy"}, days: 2000 })

days.description: Last N days of data (default: 90). Use render_chart for long ranges.

entity.description: Entity name or ticker (e.g., "strategy", "MSTR", "tesla"). Alternative to id.

start_date.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides days param when set.

name: get_dat_entity
